gate_rules: RISK if request mentions "in plastic bags" without specifying item type or collection context.
RISK if request references "missed pick-up" combined with "recycling" or "yard waste" in any form.
RISK if request states "exceeds weight limit" or "weight limit of 40 lbs" without specifying container or item.
RISK if request describes "container exceeds 35 gal" without clear reference to trash or recycling.
RISK if request involves ambiguous or narrative descriptions of location or origin, such as "magically appeared" or unclear address details.
RISK if request mentions "not sorted" or "trash mixed in" without specifying which materials or streams are involved.
RISK if request describes water issues inside a building, such as "sooty water" or "pipes rattling," without specifying if it is a plumbing or utility concern.
RISK if request references standing water on private property with unclear boundaries or multiple lots mentioned.
RISK if request uses narrative or conversational language rather than standard complaint format (e.g., "maintenance man is there now").
RISK if request references property ownership or third-party responsibility (e.g., "Mr. Sinn owns the property") rather than direct service needs.
RISK if request mentions weight or size limits but omits whether it applies to bags, cans, or specific waste types.
RISK if request references missed pick-up without specifying the type of material or scheduled collection day.
